title: Detecting Hate Speech in Memes Using Multimodal Deep Learning Approaches: Prize-winning solution to Hateful Memes Challenge
benchmark_measurement: Hate speech detection, which is defined as a direct attack on people based on protected characteristics, including religious affiliation.
findings: The paper includes 'religious affiliation' as one of the protected categories in its definition of hate speech. However, it does not provide any specific analysis, breakdown of results, or findings related to religious hate speech. The focus is on the overall performance of detecting multimodal hate speech across all categories.
